label: apr19-presence-penalty-language-model-only-wired
context:
Patched 5 scripts based on Qwen3.6 Reddit/NVIDIA forum/X research scan on Apr 19. 9 patches applied across 5 scripts.

CHANGES MADE:
1. min_p=0.2, top_k=40 → presence_penalty=1.5, top_k=20 (official Qwen3.6 thinking mode settings, prevents infinite thinking loops)
2. Added --language-model-only to ALL vLLM serve commands (skips vision encoder, frees ~2-3GB VRAM for KV cache)
3. Added --override-generation-config to spark-day1.sh (was missing entirely)

BF16 for quality training, FP8 for speed inference — confirmed with Danny
